brief: A right roundhouse kick: the hips turned at least 60 deg to the left at impact, the shin landing on the target's hips at 0.7 s, the left foot planted.
notes: Fighter 2 is a still target facing the hero. 30 fps. 'Hips turned' is the pelvis joint's twist (+ = to his left).

asserts.line: right shin touches fighter 2 hips at 0.7 s +-2 f
pelvis twist above 60 deg at 0.7 s +-2 f
right knee below 40 deg bend at 0.7 s +-2 f
